title_zh: 重置NHTSA燃油经济性计划：商用中重型公路车辆和工作卡车
title_original: Resetting NHTSA's Fuel Economy Program: Commercial Medium- and Heavy-Duty On-Highway Vehicles and Work Trucks
summary_zh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）发布解释性规则，明确其根据《2007年能源独立与安全法案》（EISA）对商用中重型公路车辆和工作卡车的燃油经济性标准制定权限仅限于车辆本身，不包括单独为发动机设定标准。该规则自2026年8月31日起适用，并将在后续单独规则制定中审查现有标准的一致性。此举旨在确保法规在法律授权范围内，并给予制造商灵活性。
content_evidence: DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION National Highway Traffic Safety Administration 49 CFR Parts 523, 534, and 535 [Docket No. NHTSA-2026-1948] Resetting NHTSA's Fuel Economy Program: Commercial Medium- and Heavy-Duty On-Highway Vehicles and Work Trucks AGENCY: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), Department of Transportation (DOT). ACTION: Interpretive rule. SUMMARY: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is issuing this interpretive rule regarding the scope of its authority to set fuel economy standards for commercial medium- and heavy-duty on-highway vehicles and work trucks. This rule describes NHTSA's authority to set vehicle standards, which does not include the authority to set separate standards for engines. NHTSA will review its existing standards applicable to commercial medium- and heavy-duty on-highway vehicles and work trucks for consistency with this interpretation in a separate rulemaking. evidence_quotes: NHTSA's authority to set vehicle standards, which does not include the authority to set separate standards for engines.
EISA specifically requires NHTSA set standards for vehicles, and authorized separate standards for different classes of vehicles, but did not authorize standalone engine standards.
This interpretive rule is applicable as of August 31, 2026.

title_zh: AV框架更新及临时指南征求意见；评论期延长
title_original: AV Framework Updates and Request for Comments on Interim Guidance; Extension of Comment Period
summary_zh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）宣布将2026年7月31日发布的关于AV框架更新及自动驾驶车辆商业部署豁免临时指南的公众评论期延长30天，至2026年9月30日。该指南旨在为根据49 U.S.C. 30113和49 CFR part 555申请一般豁免的制造商提供更多指导，特别是针对配备自动驾驶系统（ADS）的车辆。延长评论期是应汽车创新联盟（Auto Innovators）的请求，以促进更深入的公众参与。
content_evidence: DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION National Highway Traffic Safety Administration [Docket No. NHTSA-2026-1552] AV Framework Updates and Request for Comments on Interim Guidance; Extension of Comment Period AGENCY: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), Department of Transportation (DOT). ACTION: Extension of comment period. SUMMARY: In response to a request from the Alliance for Automotive Innovation (Auto Innovators), NHTSA is announcing a 30-day extension of the public comment period for the notice published on July 31, 2026 summarizing NHTSA's recent activity relating to the AV Framework and requesting comment on interim guidance for commercial deployment exemptions for automated vehicles. The comment period for the notice was originally scheduled to end on August 31, 2026. It will now end on September 30, 2026.
